name: What mistakes could accidentally make my website invisible to AI search?

mainEntity.name: What mistakes could accidentally make my website invisible to AI search?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common risks include blocking AI crawlers via robots.txt, hiding content behind heavy JavaScript, or publishing outdated information that AI flags as low-quality. If your site has these issues, AI models will skip your content entirely, leading to zero visibility even if you have strong traditional SEO rankings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Blocking crawlers, hiding content in JavaScript, or publishing outdated/low-quality content.
